Specs: 9:16 vertical. Instagram: 15s-90s (30s sweet spot). TikTok: 15s-3min (60s optimal). Resolution: 1080x1920px. Add captions.
Goal: Reach and new followers. Highest organic reach format on both platforms.
Best For: Educational quick tips, transformations, trends, how-to, storytelling, product demos

Goal: Education, saves, and engagement. Highest save rate format.
column11: First slide must stop the scroll (treat like a hero image). Last slide = CTA. Use consistent design template. LinkedIn carousels uploaded as PDFs.
column12: Carousels get 3x more reach than single images (Instagram algorithm rewards slide-through rate). LinkedIn document posts have highest engagement rate.

column11: Portrait (4:5) takes up more screen space = more impressions. High-quality photography outperforms stock. Text on image should be <20% of space for Facebook ads.
column12: Lowest organic reach format (carousels and Reels outperform). Works best for brand consistency and aesthetic building.

Keywords: story 24 hours ephemeral vertical full screen poll quiz sticker interactive
Specs: 9:16 vertical. 1080x1920px. 15 seconds per story frame. 24-hour lifespan. Safe zones: keep content away from top 250px and bottom 350px.
Goal: Daily touch point, engagement, behind-the-scenes, quick updates, driving traffic
Best For: Behind-the-scenes, polls, Q&A, countdowns, swipe-up links (10k+ followers), quick tips
Tips: Post daily to stay top-of-mind. Use interactive stickers (polls, questions, quizzes) for high engagement. Story highlights preserve best content. Add location and hashtag sticker for extra reach.
Performance: 60% of Instagram Stories are watched with sound on. Interactive stickers increase views by 83%. Stories are watched by existing followers more than new audiences.

Specs: 280 characters per tweet. Threads: 2-25 tweets. First tweet = hook. Number tweets (1/, 2/, etc.) for readability.
Goal: Viral reach and follower growth (threads outperform single tweets dramatically)
column11: Lead tweet must be your absolute best hook. Keep each tweet a single idea. Use 'Thread 🧵' at end of first tweet. End with summary tweet + CTA.
column12: Threads get 3-5x more impressions than single tweets. Strong hooks on threads can bring 1,000-5,000 new followers per viral thread.

Specs: Upload PDF as 'document' post. Dimensions: 1:1.294 ratio (816x1056px ideal). Max 300 pages (10 is sweet spot). Treat page 1 as a hook slide.

Best For: Educational slideshows, frameworks, guides, research summaries, checklists, templates

Performance: LinkedIn document posts get 3x higher organic reach vs text posts. They receive the most impressions and professional engagement of any LinkedIn format.

Specs: Text only (no image). Under 3,000 characters for optimal performance. Line breaks every 1-2 sentences. First 2-3 lines are visible before 'see more'.
column10: Use line breaks aggressively (short paragraphs = scannable). First 2 lines are your hook before 'see more' cutoff. Hashtags at the bottom (3-5).
column11: Text-only posts often outperform image posts on LinkedIn when the content is strong. Algorithm values dwell time — good text posts get people to stop and read.
